item.title: Saudi Arabia says fire extinguished at Aramco facility in Jizan
item.description: No casualties were reported after the flames broke out early on Sunday, the Saudi Energy Ministry says.

item.title: Nagasaki mayor says ‘humanity and nuclear weapons cannot coexist’
item.description: Nagasaki Mayor says ‘humanity and nuclear weapons can't coexist’ as Japan marks anniversary of the US atomic bombing.

item.title: World number one Sabalenka upset by Alexandrova at Canadian Open
item.description: Ekaterina Alexandrov took down four-time Grand Slam singles champion Aryna Sabalenka in a three-set marathon in Toronto.

item.title: Israel announces tender for 627 settler units in occupied West Bank
item.description: New settlement tender in West Bank deepens Israeli efforts to sever Palestinian ties to Jerusalem, officials warn.

item.title: Wildfire forces thousands of evacuations in Western Canada
item.description: A fast-moving wildfire has forced more than 20,000 people to evacuate parts of British Columbia’s Okanagan region.

item.title: Lionel Messi returns to Argentina after father Jorge’s death
item.description: Football star Lionel Messi returned to Argentina with his family on Saturday, a day after his father died.

item.title: Iran issues new demands as Pezeshkian seeks deal
item.description: Senior Iranian security official sets broader conditions for reopening Hormuz.

item.title: ‘Very painful’: Joe Biden’s cancer has spread, son Hunter says
item.description: Joe Biden’s son, Hunter Biden, says his father’s prostate cancer has “metastasised into his bones and further”.

item.title: Car bomb hits Colombia highway day after new president sworn in
item.description: A car bomb destroyed a toll booth on a highway in Colombia a day after President Abelardo de la Espriella was sworn in.

item.title: Iran seeks way out of ‘neither war nor peace’ stalemate with US
item.description: Iran President Pezeshkian said he hopes talks with Oman can end the “neither war nor peace” state of relations with US.

item.title: Ghana’s cashew apples get a second life
item.description: A fruit long left to rot could become a new source of income for Ghana’s cashew farmers.

item.title: Helicopter crash kills pilot and crew member amid Utah wildfire battle
item.description: Utah wildfire suppression efforts continued, with containment standing at 24 percent.

item.title: Israeli settler attacks rise as West Bank residents lose land
item.description: Palestinians near Bethlehem describe daily settler attacks as violence rises across the West Bank.

item.title: Hungary nominates former Supreme Court chief Andras Baka for presidency
item.description: Andras Baka, a strong advocate for judicial independence, becomes governing party's pick for Hungary's next president.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran sets Hormuz terms, Houthis claim attack on Saudi site
item.description: IRGC sets conditions to reopen Strait of Hormuz as US seeks commitments to end attacks on ships in the waterway.

item.title: Turkiye says Mecca defence pact not aimed at Iran
item.description: Turkiye says the Mecca defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan does not target Iran.

item.title: Vance says US ‘destroyed’ Iran’s nuclear programme
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance claims Washington has “destroyed” Iran’s nuclear programme and degraded its military.

item.title: Four killed in helicopter crash in Brazil’s Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Three Colombian tourists are among the victims of Saturday's crash on mountainside forest of Tijuca National Park.

item.title: Crews recover 19 bodies from rubble of destroyed Gaza building
item.description: More than 8,000 people remain missing amid rubble in Gaza, with recovery efforts hindered by a lack of heavy machinery.

item.title: Car bomb attack rattles Colombia after inauguration of hardline president
item.description: Government promises harsh response following explosives attack on Pan-American Highway in southwest of country.

item.title: Will Pakistan-Saudi-Turkiye defence pact change US strategy?
item.description: Some experts say the deal precipitates a larger strategic shift in Middle East while others say it reinforces US goals.

item.title: Trump’s Former Lawyer Is Now Attorney General
item.description: Todd Blanche, President Trump’s former lawyer, is now US attorney general.

item.title: What are the challenges facing the Mecca agreement?
item.description: Saudi Arabia turns to Turkiye and Pakistan for defence ties, raising questions overreliance on the US.

item.title: At least 200 people evacuated as wildfire rages near Lake Garda
item.description: At least 200 people have been evacuated after a wildfire broke out near Italy’s Lake Garda.

item.title: Lebanese soldiers injured while Israeli troops intrude on southern town
item.description: Soldiers disarm unexploded ordnance in Zawtar al-Gharbiyah, near where Israeli forces reportedly built an earth barrier.
